question: ‘A’ can complete the 60% of the work in 9 days, while ‘B’ can complete the work in 7(1)/(2) days. If they work together, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A complete the 60% of work = 9 days

B complete the work = 7(1)/(2) days

**Formula used:**

W = E × T Where, W = Work, E = Efficiency, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let they together can complete the work in X days

A can complete the work = {9over 3} times 5 = 15 days 

B can complete the work = {15over 2} days = 7.5 days

One day work of A = {1over 15}

One day work of B = {1over 7.5}

According to the question

⇒ {Xover 15} + {Xover 7.5} = {1}

By solving the equation

The value of X = 5

**∴ The required result will be 5.**
